integrity: The proof handles all finite groups; enumeration is independent corroboration only. The earliest date records the verified day of public author-uploaded full text, not an inferred original journal day.
scientific_limitations: The count bounds and asymptotic concern inverse monoids of restrictions of finite regular left actions. They are not exact finite group-specific commuting-pair counts, the exponential factor is not claimed optimal, and no exhaustive publication-priority certification has been performed.
title: A uniform inverse-square commutativity law for regular-action restriction monoids
